Dear [Mr Innes](/person/744)
I am afraid I never answered about the MS.

It will not do being too much of the mere novelette. I do not object to such dénouements, but a story ought, I think to turn on something besides.
[Miss Coleridge](/person/329) has £5 a year for her work upon Debatable Ground. I do not know if that was mentioned but she has not had it yet. I think you have her new address.
I think you have all the addresses this time except
Padre Agostino
[Mrs Morgan Morgan](/person/1055)
St Peter’s Parsonage Peterhead NB
Workhouse Infirmary
[Miss Cazenove](/person/274)
Ravensleigh
Betchworth
Mother Carey
[Miss Bramston](/person/198)
41 Dingwall Road
Croydon
She - as you know is an author with a name

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]:
